notes.title: Quick bug fix. V1.0.3
notes.notes:
Just a few bugs fixed! Small update!

-Fixed achievements
-Fixed some meta data (Nothing important)
-Removed music option. (Always on) 
Creates a weird bug that didn't make sounds play. The only way I found to fix it at the moment was to keep the music always on. (Temporary fix)

Report any bugs! 

Thank you for playing the game!

-KevinTheWolfy!

notes.title: Update 1 Official post
notes.notes:
[h1]Update 1 Official post[/h1]

Welcome to the first official post for Early access! What will be inside the early access edition? There is currently 8 playable mini games! Achievements! Gifts you can buy inside the game shop! And there is more to come in future updates!

Early access will be coming soon! (I’m waiting for approval) but I’m hoping to get it out by April 25th! Then there will be updates every month hopefully, it should add new content for you all to play!


What will be coming in future update!

- balance the tokens (kinda unfair atm)
- More use for the the tokens, (you can buy 4 items from the shop, then you unlock a mode to waste them,)
- Add a game mode that used the freaks in a survival fashion.
- A in-game music tab? (Idk yet)
- Add music to the mini games! (2/5)
- Make a demo to story mode? (Maybe a game mechanic show off?)
- A prize for wasting tokens
- Developer commentary! (Eventually)
- Fix loading screen issues
-Add some details (idk exactly yet)
-Add the Gamejolt API?
-Add the Steam API?
-More to come! 

Thank you guys for all the support! I’ll see you all in the next post! :)

-KevinTheWolfy 

P.s: Don’t forget, Bork!
